page.title: Claudius
page.meta_description: Claudius is the usurping king of Hamlet, the target of the ghost's charge and of the play-within-the-play that catches his conscience. Related pages:…
page.content:
King of Denmark who murdered Hamlet's father and married Gertrude.

How Claudius connects

  • Work: Hamlet — Claudius is the usurping king Hamlet is charged to kill.
  • Character: Hamlet (prince) — Hamlet's revenge is aimed at King Claudius.

What is Claudius?

Claudius is the usurping king of Hamlet, the target of the ghost's charge and of the play-within-the-play that catches his conscience.

Key threads lead to Hamlet and Hamlet (prince).
